value.rationale: The continuous all-dimensional family is geometrically motivated by sparse planar outward perturbations of the ball, with a sharp activation threshold controlled jointly by ambient dimension and regular-polygon inradius. Complete exact inner and outer ellipsoids, a nontrivial positive contact-ring description, and a C¹/non-C² volume-ratio transition are useful structural information not furnished by generic optimizers or simple normalization arguments.
